description: Stored term credit maximums and minimums, with the CGPA bands they apply to, for each bylaw. Rules are evaluated in priority order; individual student limits are not edited here.

protocol.title: Registry invariant protocol
protocol.before: Credit rules are bound to the bylaw of each cohort. Values marked
protocol.after: were never stated by the source article; they stay empty and are never filled with an assumed number.

stats.statedHint: of {{total}} rules carry a stated value
stats.bylawsHint: Each keeps its own priority order
stats.actionRequired: Action required: confirm with the source
stats.noGaps: Every rule has a stated value

gapAlert.title: Open data gap on credit limits

tableCaption: Credit-limit rules of the {{bylaw}}, in priority order

empty.title: No rules for this bylaw
empty.body: Add the credit-limit rules from the bylaw article, in the order they are evaluated.

footer.order: Lowest priority number wins among the rules that match a student.

chart.title: Credit ceilings by standing
chart.caption: Maximum credits per rule, in priority order
chart.empty: This bylaw has no maximum-credit rules.
chart.note: Bars show the stated maximum of each rule. A dashed bar is a band whose maximum the bylaw does not state; the forecast counts those students as having no known cap.

authority.title: Administrative authority boundaries
authority.scopeBody: Maintains the stored bylaw limits, their CGPA bands and evaluation order, with the source article for each rule.
authority.prohibitedBody: Changing an individual student's limit, granting exceptions, or filling an unstated value with an assumed number.

form.description: Copy the rule exactly as the bylaw article states it. Leave a value empty when the article does not state it.
form.priorityHint: Must be unique within the bylaw. Lower is evaluated first.
form.maxCreditsHint: Empty means the source does not state it. Never enter 0 for an unknown value.
form.minCreditsHint: Empty means this rule sets no floor.
form.unstatedNote: With no maximum and no minimum, this rule is stored as "not stated" and flagged as a data gap.
form.floorWaivedNote: With no minimum, this rule waives the fixed floor for students with fewer credits remaining.

fieldErrors.taken: Another rule of this bylaw already has this priority.
fieldErrors.must_be_positive: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
fieldErrors.must_be_zero_or_more: Enter a whole number of zero or more.
fieldErrors.must_exceed_min_cgpa: The upper bound must be greater than the lower bound.
fieldErrors.must_not_exceed_max_credits: The minimum cannot exceed the maximum.

confirm.deleteBody: The remaining rules keep their priority numbers. Students matched by this rule fall through to the next matching rule.
